NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Lets you choose a profile picture or an image to attach to your practice notes.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Lets you save your practice results and achievement badges to your photo library.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Used so you can answer speaking exercises with your voice.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Used to turn your spoken answer into text in speaking exercises.
NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: If you allow it, ads are chosen based on your interests. If you don't, the app works the same.
